policy.causal_rule: Corporate earnings and stablecoin listings establish business relationships and distribution, not a causal XRP price effect. Only synchronized, source-reconciled market observations may be considered for model admission.

edges.claim: Coinbase's Q3 SEC earnings deck reports $307M stablecoin revenue, $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products (~30% of average USDC market cap), and says it captured about half of USDC economics over the prior year. This demonstrates material USDC-linked economics; it does not disclose all contractual terms or a direct causal effect on XRP.
Ripple announced RLUSD availability on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and retail app from Oct 28. Coinbase Global Exchange collateral use was described as a future rollout.
RLUSD is supported on XRPL, Base and Ethereum. The existence of an XRPL RLUSD rail does not establish XRP as the asset used for every settlement or bridge leg.

More XRPL stablecoin activity could affect XRP demand through transaction fees, liquidity/bridge inventory or market-making, but the size and sign depend on transaction design and measured flows; no causal coefficient is established.
Long liquidations may amplify short-horizon spot/perpetual moves, but the secondary dashboard's partial venue coverage and unsynchronized timestamps prevent estimating a causal effect.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Subscription/services and USDC-related revenue can cushion Coinbase when crypto trading activity is weak.
disconfirming_evidence: Subscription/services revenue is still down year-over-year in the secondary earnings summary.
USDC-related economics remain exposed to rates, balances, issuer distribution agreements and market structure.
Coinbase's reported net income includes a large investment gain, so headline profit overstates recurring operating earnings.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase RLUSD distribution and XRPL availability may increase stablecoin access and XRPL utility without proportionate XRP spot demand.
disconfirming_evidence: No Coinbase Global Exchange collateral use was live in the announcement; it was future rollout.
No route-level bridge usage, XRP inventory demand, net exchange flow or incremental XRPL transaction volume was measured.
RLUSD can settle on Base and Ethereum as well as XRPL, so not all RLUSD growth implies XRPL activity.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive funding and high long-account share alongside substantial long liquidations may indicate fragile leveraged-long positioning.
disconfirming_evidence: Open interest was down 2.48% over 24 hours rather than expanding.
Account ratios are not notional exposure; liquidation reporting is partial and the aggregate snapshot is not synchronized across venues.
A falling market may already be unwinding longs; the panel alone does not establish future direction.
